decision: Execute an applicability test from fresh life0 before any generation-rule search.

evidence.retained: Both matched layouts improve M/E/bodytime/post256 in all four mature-state contexts; uniform is the stronger simple comparator overall.
closed: maintenance success in the completed 12 trajectories

question: Does the exact matched_uniform deletion operator retain its finite body and replacement benefit when it acts throughout formation, rather than beginning at mature clock256?

construction.rule: Same frozen g2_p0_c0 record, kernels and ready-state greedy in both arms and all four shapes; no rule or shape mutation, no initial acquired state.
construction.paired: Each seed/shape creates one complete life0 state then makes exact full-state copies into both arms; hash state/world/input maps/cursors/RNG. Each arm independently runs all 256 native steps. No acquired prefix and no old future replay.

environment.scheme: Original colocated map from TurnoverBody, each 64 steps absolute dy/dx from frozen tape; input is rolled, existing inventory is not. P/F share displacement and original gross input. No redraw/rejection of repeated or stationary tape. Use only first four blocks, stop at256.
environment.interpretation: Two new input tapes crossed with four prescribed initial geometries under one previously selected rule. Eight related contexts, not eight independent ecological worlds or a new morphology search.

mechanism.exact: Reuse pinned route_deletion unchanged. Both mass and uniform proposals are still computed, receiver-projected, and source-out matched by minimum; only matched_uniform is executed. Do not substitute unmatched uniform.
mechanism.stage: Replace D0 only after actual after-actor response and before survivor, death energy, template support and admit. All physical consequences use actual Dnew.
mechanism.invariants: Per actual state sum(Dnew)=sum(D0), 0<=Dnew<=rho; no death multiplier reduction. Preserve h, positive request, original greedy scoring, native and pump prices, basal fees and input.
mechanism.cost: The existing extra local computation is unpriced. This remains an explicit fixed-rule model assumption, not learned regulation or fully costed implementation.

execution.order: For each seed in declared order and each shape in declared order run both arms in declared order; retain all failures and do not select children.
execution.boundary: Exactly four fresh shape states at seed5601: one original GrowthBody step and one off-hook LayoutRate step each, 8 affected-check native. Compare actual states/receipts/accounts; this explicitly budgeted check is separate from 4096 science. All other tests pure arrays/roundtrip.
execution.control: Re-read research.desired_state/started immediately before job submission; paused/stopped prohibits starting. Aggregate all attempts/time; no unknown native replay. Freeze plan and sources before first native.
execution.completion: Keep complete checkpoints at stage boundaries and final recovery state. Reporting/logging failure may use same-job explicit recovery only when actual completed native is known; no replay or extra job without a new decision. End at256 even if negative; no parameter/price/tape/window rescue.

measurements.labels: Observer-only founder and actual post-life0 tissue throughout. At128 register L128=rho once, track via actual K and actor/rule survival with born0; post128 actual retained newborn tissue independently reconstructs body. No cohort/future input to rule.
measurements.every_step: M/E/U/bodytime, requested/paid/actual birth, actor/rule death, registered labels and retained tissue, all original costs/heat/input/export/arrears, per-state deletion match, physical and label balances. All cells are dependent, not samples.
measurements.views: Inspect actual time sequences for all four shapes and both arms, including failed formation; separate predefined initial geometry from observed emergent form.

evaluation.formation: Report M128 and M256>=32 counts and exact extinction for every arm; no survivor-only analysis or deployment selection.
evaluation.finite_transfer: For each of eight pairs report M256,E256,whole-window bodytime, actual post128 retained tissue, founder/L128, and costs. A common benefit claim requires no worse M/E/bodytime/post128 in all eight pairs within1e-8 and at least one strictly positive substantive metric in each pair; report mixed signs without collapsing to a score.
evaluation.maintenance: Predeclared windows1..64,65..128,129..192,193..256. Original joint gate: born-death>=-1e-8, deltaE>=-1e-8,minM>=32 in every tested window; separately report all-four and last-two gates and zero-tolerance sensitivity. No alternate endpoint selection.
evaluation.boundary: Finite256 applicability, not steady state, generalized adaptation, experience learning or novel trained method. Do not equate founder preservation with replacement.

handoff: Owner implements and actually runs this single batch, then reports exact scientific outcome/next actionable choice once to PI. Merge paper/projection evidence in existing items; routine updates only shared state, no broadcasts/timers. No autonomous scan or training on remaining balance.
